about.hero_subtitle: We manufacture ready-mix concrete and reinforced concrete products in Almaty: concrete of various grades, well rings and plates, splitter blocks and columns.
about.mission_text: JSI Beton Almaty LLP is a manufacturer of ready-mix concrete and reinforced concrete products in Almaty. We produce concrete of various grades delivered to your site, well rings and plates (KS, PP, PN), splitter blocks, columns/pillars and interior partition blocks.
about.mission_text_2: We work directly from production — no middlemen — which allows us to keep competitive prices and fulfill orders of any volume promptly, from private builders to large construction companies.
about.history_text: The company was registered on November 14, 2005, and has been operating in the Almaty market for over 20 years. We specialize in the production of ready-mix concrete and precast reinforced concrete structures and products. Over the years we have built up experience, our own production base, and a reputation as a reliable supplier of construction materials.
